title: Canonical ordinary stalk model of a characteristic fan chart
statement: Let X be an fs locally Noetherian log scheme whose log structure is associated to a Zariski one [def-trf-fs-log-blowup], let F be a fine fan [def-trf-fine-fan-blowup], and let c from the sharp monoidal space of X to F induce bijections on all characteristic stalks (equivalently its inverse-image characteristic sheaf map is an isomorphism). For x in X, put R=N_Z,x and P=P_F,c(x). There is a normalized affine localization L at c(x) [lem-trf-fine-fan-point-localization] and a monoid equivalence e: Associates R ≃ P whose composite with the quotient R → Associates R is the canonical stalk quotient constructed from c. The canonical map R → R^gp is injective; P is fine saturated and sharp, and P^gp has a finite integer basis. No group section or neighborhood log-chart lift is asserted.

proof.text: Localize the fan at c(x). The normalized affine open of generalizations and its germ isomorphism give the PointLocalization, including normalization and fineness.

The restriction of a Zariski log structure to ordinary opens satisfies the log unit axiom. Stalks commute with the quotient by units and with sheafification: lift finitely many representatives and unit equations to a common open. This identifies Associates of the ordinary log stalk with the sharp-space stalk, canonically on every log germ. Compose with the inverse fan-chart stalk isomorphism.

Choose a geometric point over x and an fs etale chart Q. Unit extension proves integrality of the ordinary log stalk and identifies its sharpening with Associates of Q localized at the face mapping to units. Face sharpening proves fs, sharpness, and finite freeness of its group completion. Transfer through the canonical characteristic isomorphism.

proof_origin.place: ILO VI 1.6, p.70; VIII 3.1.4(iii), 3.1.10(ii), pp.98--100; 3.3.12, p.108. Explicit subargument of lem-trf-fan-chart-local-monoid-lift.

mathlib_searches.query: The sharpening of the Zariski stalk of a fine saturated log scheme is a sharp fs monoid and its group completion is finite free
mathlib_searches.results: Returned ordinary scheme stalks, rankAtStalk_eq_finrank_of_free and Localization.fg. None identifies a logarithmic characteristic stalk.
Group completion universal property only; no characteristic comparison.
Ordinary sheaf stalks and germs, local surjectivity, and sheafification. No logarithmic characteristic comparison, finite monoid lift, or chart criterion.

from.place: Historical nearby-duality/alteration branch of lem-trf-local-term-locality, proof (1)--(2), through lem-trf-log-regular-desingularization: monoidal resolution used for the regular modification of nodal pairs; ILO VIII 3.3.15, pp.109--110. Expose VIII, 3.3.2--3.3.13, pp.106--109, especially 3.3.4(ii), 3.3.8--3.3.11, 3.3.13(i),(iii); finite cover as in proof of 3.3.15. Subargument: returned log-fan-chart-blowup proof step(s) 3,4,5; Expose VIII 3.1.4(iii), 3.1.8(ii), 3.1.10(ii), pp.98--100; 3.3.12--3.3.13, pp.108--109: Zariski local lift expanded using free characteristic groups (VI 1.6, p.70). Subargument: Canonical ordinary stalk model of a characteristic fan chart.

lean.statement:
theorem fan_chart_stalk_model
    {X : FineSaturatedLogScheme.{u}} {F : FineFan.Fan.{u}}
    (c : LogFanChart X F) (x : X.scheme) :
    ∃ (L : FineFan.PointLocalization F (c.map.hom.base x))
      (e : Associates (FineFan.stalk X.logStructure.zariskiPresheaf x) ≃*
        FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x)),
      (∀ m, e (Associates.mk m) = c.stalkQuotient x m) ∧
      Function.Injective
        (Algebra.GrothendieckGroup.of (M := FineFan.stalk X.logStructure.zariskiPresheaf x)) ∧
      IsFineSaturatedMonoid (FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x)) ∧
      FineFan.IsSharp (FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x)) ∧
      ∃ n : ℕ, Nonempty (Module.Basis (Fin n) ℤ
        (Additive (Algebra.GrothendieckGroup
          (FineFan.stalk F.space.presheaf (c.map.hom.base x)))))
